steps.title: Work through the question
steps.equation: At x=−3, f(−3)=1+m(−3+3)=1 for every m. Examples m=−1,0,1 give −x−2, 1, and x+4.

steps.title: Check the reasoning and conditions
steps.why: Changing m rotates a line about the common point; it does not change the common point's coordinates.
